DEMO: what happens when the network drops after the money is sent
Base Sepolia | AgentKit account 0x292D5dcdb6aC1F3a0452E6eB8fA26Ff6658B325d | KeeperHub wallet 0x449FE01435Af28FD60320B198219068d3f1656CB
[bootstrap] AgentKit analytics rejected and upstream did not catch it; silenced. See docs/upstream/agentkit-analytics.md

Error transferring the asset: InvalidInputRpcError: Missing or invalid parameters.
Double check you have provided the correct parameters.

[2] The error text above is all the agent receives.
    No executionId. No way to ask again.
The agent does not know whether the money left.
[3] The agent does the reasonable thing: it retries.

Error transferring the asset: InvalidInputRpcError: Missing or invalid parameters.
Double check you have provided the correct parameters.

RESULT: 2 transfers landed for ONE job.
  0xac2b2d8f318829de04173df84d291cab652bbfb2eb30c42a8136a22782f24114
  0x0e961700e867513befb50787b9f06a1e39fbf66317d937af5b990537639b54c4
  ^ the money left twice.
[1] The agent sends money through KeeperHub.

Keep both. If anything fails after this point, call get_execution_status with the executionId, or call transfer again with the same taskId to get the executionId back. Do not use a new taskId.
[2] The agent retries the same job, exactly as before.

Transfer handed to KeeperHub.

status: completed
transactionHash: 0x0684e7df191193de1cc4684fe8a8d358f9daae98a1a3f2e0281c11a02d92d3fd
Same executionId? YES: replayed, not sent again
[3] And this is what AgentKit cannot do:
the agent ASKS what actually happened.

Aborted before broadcast. Simulation predicts a revert: Error(ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance). No transaction was sent and no gas was spent.

    The simulation caught it. Zero transactions, zero gas.
